### What the source shows

`packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45` defines the single resolution rule — `resolveHideBranding` returns true whenever the **organization's** flag is set, regardless of the entity's own value — and exposes it three ways: `shouldHideBrandingForEventUsingProfile` (85-110) folding `team.parent.hideBranding` / `owner.profile.organization.hideBranding`, its wrappers `shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent` (158-164) and `shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent` (169-181), and `getHideBranding({userId, teamId})` (50-80), which resolves by **id** through `TeamRepository.findTeamWithParentHideBranding` (462-473) and `UserRepository.findUserWithHideBranding` (1323-1336).

The booking pages take the event-scoped path (`apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299`, `apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199`, `apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,103`, `apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36`, `apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:253`, `packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58`). The automation path does not.

{"contract":"Whether the product's own name and logo are suppressed for a given booking is a single derived property of that booking's event type, and it must be resolved everywhere through the shared event-scoped resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts — which folds the parent organization's hideBranding over the team's or the owner-profile's own value — so that a message an automation sends to an attendee carries exactly the branding the same customer sees on the page they book from. Reading a raw hideBranding column off one entity (the event type's owner, or the workflow's own userId/teamId), or loading a row whose select omits the team and the parent organization, breaks that contract because it silently drops the organization-level entitlement and, for team events with a null owner, drops the setting entirely.","defect_location":{"repo":"calcom/cal.com","summary":"The contract is defined at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 (resolveHideBranding returns true whenever options.organizationHideBranding is set) and exposed event-scoped at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:85-110,158-164,169-181, backed by packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-473 (selects team.hideBranding AND parent.hideBranding) and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1336 (selects user.hideBranding AND profiles[].organization.hideBranding).
